description: Does the director, handed a passing merge ask whose tier block waits for the owner, reply that it waits for him, naming the block's reasons, and relay no merge (issue-lifecycle spec #acceptance-tier-three-waits, #gates-tier-relay; #1284)? The ask is a real recorded one: `octo-feather-lane merge-ask 1 --status docs/specs/demo.status.json` on realcase PR #1 (0xTomDaniel/octo-feather-realcase, public), as the merge-tiers drive of the kit's verify skill replays it from tests/gate/kit/testkit/recordings/merge-tier-1257.json (tier 3, its Failed list), its stdout verbatim but for the state dir path of its Gate time line. herdr-say is a stand-in answering delivered (schema.md, Case, stand_ins); octo-feather-lane is the kit's own. Graded on the director's runs (schema.md, Run record): a herdr-say to the supervisor's pane, no `octo-feather-lane relay`; and on its final JSON block (schema.md, Final JSON): whom the ask waits for, each reason it names by kind and subject, and its relay. Stated limit: the reply's wording is not graded, only the block the task asks for beside it.
